pit_regression_pin.rule: a reader querying as-of T excludes every row with available_time_utc > T
pit_regression_pin.method: daily decision sweep across the revision window on a hand-built fusion table with availability stamps 2024-01-05 / 2024-01-10 / 2024-02-01; per decision T the selected row is asserted inside the visible set (available_time_utc <= T) and equal to the latest visible vintage; boundary assertions pin nothing-visible, first-revision, second-revision, hidden-Feb-row, and the <= semantics exactly at the availability stamp
